reviewMethod: Inspect original native full-resolution beauty pairs before reading numerical change scores.
Judge jaw/macro, jaw/oblique and speak/macro independently. A diffuse change at the mouth corner cannot substitute for the specified central lower return.
Require a more readable short continuous exterior-to-inner turn, without a new bright pipe, dent, shelf or second hard edge.
Preserve lip body, mouth width, original tooth geometry and contact samples; inspect if the new silhouette merely hides or exposes teeth to create a misleading impression.
Inspect neutral and pucker exact controls and the 25/50/75 percent jaw pairs for unintended changes or a visually abrupt activation.
Use actual indexed native/draw sections afterward to test whether the observed sharp turn is spread rather than moved to a neighboring boundary.
If the images do not convincingly improve, reject or iterate even if the solver, angles and checks pass.
notAcceptance: A smaller single angular statistic without the surrounding section
Only a zoomed crop appears different
scope: A local return repair can be accepted while overall lip realism, whole-volume/contact physiology and other people remain unverified.
